title: Classify the Incident
description: Given scenarios, identify the correct incident type.
problemStatement:
Read the following three scenarios. For each one, determine the **most specific** type of security incident occurring from the list: `Malware`, `Phishing`, `DDoS`, `Insider Threat`.

**Scenario A:** The company website is unreachable. The network monitoring dashboard shows 50 Gbps of incoming UDP traffic from thousands of different IP addresses targeting port 53.

**Scenario B:** A user in accounting reports that their computer is displaying a full-screen message demanding 2 Bitcoin to unlock their spreadsheets. All file extensions have been changed to `.encrypted`.

**Scenario C:** An email with the subject 'Urgent: Payroll Update Required' was sent to the HR department. The link in the email leads to `hxxps[://]payroll-login-secure[.]ru` instead of the normal company portal.

**Output Format:**
`Scenario A: [Type]`
`Scenario B: [Type]`
`Scenario C: [Type]`
hints: Scenario B mentions a specific extortion tactic involving encryption.
Scenario C is about tricking users into giving away credentials via a fake website.
expectedOutput:
Scenario A: DDoS
Scenario B: Malware (Ransomware)
Scenario C: Phishing
solutionCode:
Scenario A: DDoS
Scenario B: Malware
Scenario C: Phishing
